fullDescription: An A4 portrait EVENT-PROGRAM / schedule flyer in a strict warm analogous terracotta palette — cream #fdf4ea canvas, bright orange #ee7420 Archivo Black header, full-bleed peach #f4b183 and cream ZEBRA-STRIPE schedule rows split by a soft orange divider bar, dark rust #8a3b1a organic corner blobs — with NO cool color. A big two-line uppercase heavy-grotesque header, a black wide-tracked subhead flanked by small orange star marks, a two-cell italic-Playfair info bar (org | date), and full-width alternating peach/cream schedule rows ("time – time | session") with NO borders or grid lines, over amoeba blob shapes and faint concentric-ring motifs, closing on a footer dash + tracked rust caps. All CSS/SVG, no photos. Reusable for agendas, conference rundowns, itineraries, timetables, class schedules, retreat programs, and any list-of-rows that wants to feel designed rather than tabular.

structured.summary: An A4 portrait (1058x1497, print feel) EVENT-PROGRAM / schedule FLYER, generically branded as an original leadership-workshop program. STRICT WARM ANALOGOUS TERRACOTTA PALETTE with NO cool color anywhere: warm cream canvas #fdf4ea, bright orange #ee7420 (headline + primary accent + divider bars), peach/tan #f4b183 (the alternating schedule row stripes), lighter peach #f9dcc3 (info bar fill), dark rust / burnt-sienna #8a3b1a (organic corner blob shapes + footer caps), near-black #111 schedule text. Type does register-contrast in three voices: a HEAVY grotesque (Archivo Black; Anton / Montserrat 900 fallback) UPPERCASE in orange for the big two-line display header ('RIMBERIO / LEADERSHIP', line-height ~0.85); a bold wide-tracked (~0.25em) black UPPERCASE sans subhead ('WORKSHOP RUNDOWN') flanked LEFT and RIGHT by a small orange 5-point STAR mark; and an ITALIC transitional serif (Playfair Display) for the two-cell info bar (org name | date) and the footer series line. Layout top to bottom, centered: two organic amoeba rust #8a3b1a BLOB shapes bleed in from the top-left and top-right corners with faint low-opacity concentric-ring line motifs behind the info-bar zone; then the centered header block (orange grotesque display + star-flanked subhead); then a two-cell peach #f9dcc3 info bar split org | date by a thin cream divider; then a FULL-BLEED vertical zebra schedule of ~9 full-width rows alternating peach #f4b183 and cream #fdf4ea, each a single CENTERED 'TIME – TIME | Session' line where a half-opacity orange #ee7420 pipe '|' separates the bold time range from the session name; then a footer with a short orange dash rule above a rust #8a3b1a tracked-caps series line. The alternating stripe fills ARE the table structure — NO borders, NO grid lines, NO cell dividers between rows. All type + shapes are CSS/SVG; no photos, no illustration.

style.description: Warm print-editorial event program as a flyer: the whole mood is one strict analogous terracotta palette (cream to peach to orange to rust) with NO cool or contrasting accent, so it feels warm and unified rather than color-blocked. Three signature moves carry it: (1) a FULL-BLEED alternating peach/cream ZEBRA-STRIPE schedule where the stripe fills alone separate the rows — no borders or grid lines ever — with a soft orange pipe divider splitting time from session inside each row; (2) organic amoeba rust blob shapes plus faint concentric-ring motifs that add texture and warmth without any photo; (3) typographic register contrast between a genuinely HEAVY grotesque uppercase display in orange and a small ITALIC transitional serif info bar, with a wide-tracked black subhead flanked by little orange star marks. Confident, warm, art-directed, print-ready.
style.prompt: Design an A4 portrait event-program / schedule FLYER. STRICT WARM ANALOGOUS TERRACOTTA PALETTE, no cool color: cream canvas #fdf4ea, bright orange #ee7420 header/accent/divider, peach #f4b183 schedule stripes, lighter peach #f9dcc3 info bar, dark rust #8a3b1a organic blobs + footer caps, near-black #111 text. Use a genuinely HEAVY grotesque (Archivo Black; Anton / Montserrat 900 fallback, never a medium sans) UPPERCASE in orange for a big two-line display header with tight leading, a bold wide-tracked black sans subhead flanked left and right by a small orange 5-point star, and an ITALIC transitional serif (Playfair Display) for a two-cell info bar (org | date) and the footer series line. Build the schedule as full-bleed full-width rows alternating peach #f4b183 and cream #fdf4ea ZEBRA STRIPES — the stripe fills ARE the table, NO borders, NO grid lines — each row centering a bold 'TIME – TIME' + a half-opacity orange pipe '|' + a light session name. Add two organic amoeba rust blob shapes bleeding from the top corners plus faint low-opacity concentric-ring motifs behind the info bar. Close with a short orange dash rule above a rust tracked-caps series line. All CSS/SVG, no photos, no illustration, no icons besides the small star marks and the pipe divider.

layout_and_structure.description: A single A4 portrait column, centered, top to bottom: (1) two organic rust #8a3b1a amoeba blob shapes bleeding in from the top-left and top-right corners, with faint low-opacity concentric-ring line motifs behind the upper content as texture; (2) a centered header block — a big two-line UPPERCASE heavy-grotesque display in orange #ee7420 ('RIMBERIO / LEADERSHIP'), then a bold wide-tracked black subhead flanked left and right by a small orange star mark; (3) a two-cell peach #f9dcc3 info bar split into a left cell (org name, italic Playfair) and a right cell (date, Playfair) by a thin cream divider; (4) a FULL-BLEED vertical zebra schedule of ~9 full-width rows alternating peach #f4b183 and cream #fdf4ea, each flexing to fill height, centering a bold time range + a soft orange '|' divider + a light session name, the stripe fills alone structuring the table with NO borders; (5) a footer with a short orange dash rule above a rust tracked-caps series line.

prompts.prompt: On a cream #fdf4ea A4 portrait canvas, draw two organic amoeba BLOB shapes in dark rust #8a3b1a as irregular soft-curved SVG blob paths bleeding in from the top-LEFT corner and the top-RIGHT corner (each partly off-canvas, ~38-46% width). Behind the upper content add faint concentric-ring line motifs — several low-opacity (~7%) stroked rust circles sharing a center near the info-bar zone — as subtle texture. No photos, no illustration.

prompts.prompt: Centered near the top: a big two-line UPPERCASE display header in a genuinely HEAVY grotesque (Archivo Black; Anton / Montserrat 900 fallback), bright orange #ee7420, tight leading (~0.85) ('RIMBERIO / LEADERSHIP'). Below it a bold wide-tracked (~0.25em) black #111 UPPERCASE subhead ('WORKSHOP RUNDOWN') centered, with a small orange #ee7420 5-point STAR mark set immediately to its LEFT and its RIGHT as symmetric dividers so mark-word-mark reads as one unit.

Below the header, a peach #f9dcc3 bar at ~84% width split into two equal cells by a thin cream #fdf4ea vertical divider. Left cell: org name in ITALIC Playfair Display, black #111 ('Rimberio Studio'). Right cell: the date in roman Playfair Display ('29 October 2030'). Comfortable vertical padding; both centered.

prompts.prompt: A FULL-BLEED vertical schedule of ~9 full-width rows stacked directly, each flexing to share the remaining height, alternating fill cream #fdf4ea (odd) and peach #f4b183 (even). Each row is a single CENTERED line: a bold time range, then a half-opacity orange #ee7420 pipe '|' with side margins, then the session name in a light/regular sans, black #111 — e.g. '08:30 – 09:00 | Registration & Welcome Coffee'. CRITICAL: the alternating stripe fills ARE the table structure — add NO borders, NO horizontal grid lines, NO cell dividers. Rows: 08:30-09:00 Registration & Welcome Coffee / 09:00-09:30 Opening Keynote / 09:30-10:15 Leading Through Change / 10:15-10:30 Morning Break / 10:30-11:30 Team Alignment Workshop / 11:30-12:15 Decision-Making Under Pressure / 12:15-13:15 Networking Lunch / 13:15-14:00 Feedback That Builds / 14:00-15:00 Closing Reflections.

Below the schedule, center a short orange #ee7420 dash rule (~8% width, thick) above a rust #8a3b1a UPPERCASE tracked (~0.2em) Playfair series line ('MODERN LEADERSHIP SERIES'), small. Generous air around it.

special_ui_components.component: Full-bleed zebra schedule with pipe divider
special_ui_components.description: The alternating-fill schedule that replaces a bordered grid, with an in-row divider bar.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build the schedule as full-bleed full-width rows stacked directly, alternating background fill cream #fdf4ea / peach #f4b183, each flexing to share the height. Let the alternating stripes ALONE separate the rows — NO borders, NO horizontal rules, NO grid lines. Inside each row center a bold time range + a half-opacity orange #ee7420 pipe '|' (with margin) + a light session name. The pipe splits time from session so the two-part unit survives across same-value stripe boundaries; the zebra fill is the table, a grid line would break the design.

Add faint concentric-ring line motifs — several low-opacity stroked circles sharing a center — behind the upper content as texture. special_ui_components.component: Heavy grotesque header + italic-serif info bar
special_ui_components.description: Typographic register contrast between a heavy display and an italic serif bar.
special_ui_components.prompt: Set the display header in a genuinely HEAVY grotesque (Archivo Black; Anton / Montserrat 900 fallback), UPPERCASE, bright orange #ee7420, as a big tight two-line stack — never substitute a light or medium sans. Answer it with a two-cell info bar in a transitional serif (Playfair Display), ITALIC for the org name and roman for the date, so the heavy grotesque and the elegant serif create deliberate register contrast.

special_ui_components.description: A tracked subhead symmetrically flanked by small orange star marks.
special_ui_components.prompt: Set the subhead in a bold wide-tracked (~0.25em) black UPPERCASE sans, centered, with a small orange #ee7420 5-point star mark placed immediately to its LEFT and its RIGHT as symmetric dividers, so mark-word-mark reads as a single centered ornamental unit. Keep the stars small so they punctuate rather than compete.

special_notes: PALETTE IS LAW: cream #fdf4ea, orange #ee7420, peach #f4b183, lighter peach #f9dcc3, rust #8a3b1a, near-black #111 text — and NO cool color anywhere. The 'accent' is just the most saturated member of the same warm family (orange), never a color from across the wheel.

FONTS: header in Archivo Black (fallback Anton, then Montserrat 900 — never a medium/normal-width sans or the register contrast collapses); info bar + footer in Playfair Display (italic for org name, roman/900 for date and titles); schedule/session text in a light system/grotesk sans. Load from Google Fonts.

THE ZEBRA IS THE TABLE: never add borders, horizontal rules, or cell dividers to the schedule; the alternating cream/peach fills do 100% of the row separation. The only in-row line allowed is the half-opacity orange pipe '|' between time and session.
Canvas is fixed 1058x1497 (A4 portrait ratio, 1cqw = 10.58px if authoring in container units). Print-ready: keep type crisp at 2x export; blobs and rings are SVG so they scale losslessly.

Copy is generic/placeholder ('Rimberio Leadership', 'Rimberio Studio') — swap freely; the hierarchy (header / star-subhead / info bar / zebra schedule / footer series) stays intact for any agenda, itinerary, timetable, menu of times, or retreat program.
